text.intro: Type the size of each item as width x height, one digit from 1 to 4 each, apart by spaces; the items are put in turn on a toy page of the size chosen. The table gives the spot the search picks for each one, and the grid shows the page at the end. The sizes offered first are illustrative.

caps.owner: Owner: a player (0) or any other (1)

text.gridHead: The page after the last item (letters in the order given, . free):
text.errBad: A token is not a size of two digits from 1 to 4 around an x:
text.errLong: More than 12 items were typed; nothing is placed.
text.note: Computed by our model of the placement search, not observed in the game. Left out: the size an item really has, the other pages and their sizes, a page that already holds items, and what happens after the spot is chosen. Columns and rows count from 0.
